The '''Ewok Tree Village''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It belonged to the [[Panshee]] tribe.<ref name="SWG:ETV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok Tree Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ETV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, there were two Ewok tree villages and both were simply called an "Ewok Tree Village,"<ref name="SWG:ETV" /> however the game's directory tree files and source data give the more specific name of '''Central Panshee Ewok Village'''.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref>
